items.title: Intergalactic Paladins
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Help keep the vast territory of outer space safe and free. Choose from 8 different armored skins complete with hooded helmet. Travel from galaxy to galaxy and defend from enemies great and small when you role-play as a stellar knight. Even the universe needs protection!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Digi-Mobs
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
These mobs are on a whole new level! Gear up and get wired when you choose from 12 super skins that have gone digital. Role-play as your favorite hostile, passive or neutral mobile entity, with a modern cyber twist. Remember: Analog is out, and digital is in!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Trending Teens
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Lead the way and others will surely follow! Role-play in brightly colored outfits and all the latest fabulous fashions. Choose from 12 different popular skins with sporty hoodies and more. Before you know it, everyone will want to copy your stylish teen ways. You’re here to set the trends!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Masked Anime Fashion
items.creator: Meraki
items.description:
The masked anime teens are here with their new fashionable outfits! No one has ever seen their faces, but we all know that their masks look awesome and compliment their clothes. 

- 10 masked anime skins
- by Meraki

items.title: Anime Kimono Style
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Do you love Japanese fashion? Well, these kimonos are perfect for you! Pick your favorite skin now and feel like you're walking the streets of Tokyo!

+ 12 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Anime themed
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Starblocks Skins
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Open up your own Café using these coffee skins! Perfect for role playing.

+ 10 Coffee Skins
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Demons And Casters
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Become a master of the Dark Arts using the Demons & Casters skins! Perfect for role playing magical games.

+ 10 magical skins
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Biome Run
items.creator: Yeggs
items.description:
Ready to run? Parkour on 8 different biomes with varying challenges and difficulties! Play by yourself and complete a run as fast as possible, or race with your friends!

+ 8 biome levels
+ Checkpoints
+ Timer
+ Try finishing every biome, there might be a secret level!

items.title: Cool Mobs Universe
items.creator: Chillcraft
items.description:
Have fun in your friends worlds with these teen mob skins. Each skin has a unique theme that you can take advantage of to create different adventures. Would you like to become a cool Creeper?

- Includes a free skin!
- 12 Custom mob skins.

items.title: Enchanted Teens
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Ready to become a beautiful enchanted teen? Well you can with these cool shiny purple outfits with glowing eyes! Perfect for all your enchanted armor you are already wearing in game! Suit up and pick your favorite and epic skin!

- 8 enchanted purple skins!
- 1 free skin!
- PVP ready!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Bed Wars Bundle
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
This game includes 4 unique bed wars maps!
What is bed wars?
Bed Wars is a classic strategy PVP minigame. You have to protect your own bed while destroying the enemies beds and kill your opponents in a fun and action loaded fight. Without a bed, you can’t respawn.

+ 4 maps
+ Multiplayer only
+ Custom villager trades
+ Action
+ Fun minigame
+ 2 skins + 2 free skins

items.title: Floating Life: Tree House
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: Live life in luxury amongst the clouds in a huge tree surrounded on all sides by beautiful and mysterious floating islands. Make this tree house your home and create the perfect life as you imagine it. From farms to villagers to underground caves there is plenty to explore. Can you find all the hidden locations?

items.title: Winter Smiles
items.creator: Asiago Bagels
items.description:
Grab your winter coat, but also don't forget your smiley face mask! Dream about making a snowman, and then go conquer that dream!

+ 12 winter skins

items.title: One Block Challenge
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Skyblock is too easy for you? Then try your hand at the ONE BLOCK CHALLENGE! 
Whenever you mine the block you get a random item or block!

items.title: Spiral Caves Parkour
items.creator: Chillcraft
items.description:
In this spiral parkour you will have to overcome more than 40 levels of parkour through 30 biomes and structures. Explore lush caves and complete checkpoints using unique power-ups. Play with your friends co-op or compete against yourself. You do the challenge.

- More than 40 unique levels
- New types of cave never seen before
- ¡Multiplayer ready!
- Includes 2 skins

items.title: Goth Fashion
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
It is time to switch up from colorful summer fashion to dark goth outfits! Grab your favorite goth skin and revel in the darkness! Dominate the fashion game while playing your favorite game mode, or while chilling out with your friends!

- 8 skins
- by inPixel

items.title: Masked Speedrunners
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
Speedrun like a pro!

Choose any of these masked speedrunner skins for your next survival world!

items.title: New Years 2022
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description: Happy New Year! Celebrate 2022 in style with these epic teen skins.

items.title: Scape in 60 minutes
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
Be prepared to escape in just 60 minutes, put to the test your intelligence, ability, and time control, will you be able to?

+Play alone or with your friends
+Amazing puzzles
+2 Skins
by Underblocks

items.title: Savage Demons
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Walk through the city in your new demon outfit and get to know every citizen! Have a great time with your friends and try to get into the most exclusive clubs. We have them all: suits, casual wear, and training outfits. Try each style to see what fits you best and join the party!

+ 1 free skin
+ 16 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Skyblock Parkour IV
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Parkour! Another new track means another new perfect run to complete! Parkour your way up to the top and see what the view is like from above! Once you're done, a new life of survival begins! Good luck!

items.title: Aesthetic Teens
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Do you love anime and fancy outfits? Well, we have the perfect fit for you. Show off the most modern outfits as these Aesthetic Teens! Walk around with your friends while standing out in the crowd!

+ 12 anime-themed skins
+ 1 free skin
+ Licensed by Environ Studios and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Holiday Emoji Party
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Time to celebrate the holidays together! Don’t forget to wear your emoji masks and show the party how you’re feeling!

- 10 skins in festive party wear and emoji masks!
- Licensed by The Pocalypse Studios and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Funky Festive Outfits
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
The festive season is here, woohoo! It's also time to get funky and fun with these super awesome outfits. Whether you want to be a present, funky reindeer, elf creeper, or any other ones, you get to be the most festive one out there! 

- 13 AMAZING skins
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from UniDesigns.
